page.layout: One page of handwritten text, a list of books, with item numbers in the left margin.
page.notes: Handwritten manuscript, not a printed page. The left-margin numbers are item numbers written beside the entries; their exact placement is approximate. The word after "brevis &" in the Catechismus line is not legible. Several words in the entries are written in a cursive hand and are uncertain (e.g. "Catachesis", "Tigurina"), so their spelling may not be exact. The line "Confessio Ecclesiae Helveticae" was read with some doubt.
